title: Sheinbaum Sets Monday Ayotzinapa Report Ahead of 12th Anniversary March
detail: On September 25, 2026 President Sheinbaum confirmed that the government's first public report on the Ayotzinapa case would be delivered Monday, September 28, by Human Rights Undersecretary Arturo Medina and special prosecutor Mauricio Pazarán. The report is to cover new lines of investigation, search operations, attention to the victims' parents and new detentions, following the August arrest of ex-Guerrero governor Ángel Aguirre. A march from the Ángel de la Independencia to the Zócalo was called for September 26, the twelfth anniversary of the 2014 disappearance of the 43 students from Iguala, which occurred under the Peña Nieto government.
